reason: Two challenge cycles produced unresolved interruption and playback decisions
decision: Pause the active response on overlapping VAD, then use overlap-scoped STT to confirm permanent stop or resume

required_behavior.candidate: VAD captures and pauses one active response without rotating context or cancelling generation
required_behavior.confirmed_interruption: Stop the captured response, invalidate matching work, rotate context once and release held STT
required_behavior.false_interruption: Discard filler-only overlap STT and resume the same captured response
required_behavior.ambiguous: Permanently stop and preserve user input

authorization: Authorizes one maintainer-directed RFC amendment and final independent challenge; does not authorize production implementation
